'''Melly S. Oitzl''' (in full: Maria-Silvana Oitzl, born 1955 in Lind/[[Arnoldstein]]) is an Austrian [[Behavioral neuroscience|behavioral neuroscientist]]. She is [[associate professor]] of [[Pharmacology|medical pharmacology]] at [[Leiden University]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.lumc.nl/con/2005/225833/110201010802313 |title=Prof. dr. Melly Oitzl |publisher=Leids Universitair Medisch Centrum |access-date=2012-11-26}}</ref> and [[adjunct professor]] of [[cognitive neuroscience|cognitive neurobiology]] at the [[University of Amsterdam]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://home.medewerker.uva.nl/m.s.oitzl/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120404154830/http://home.medewerker.uva.nl/m.s.oitzl/ |archive-date=2012-04-04 |title=prof.dr. M.S. Oitzl |publisher=University of Amsterdam |access-date=2012-12-13 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Oitzl is mainly interested in the relationships between [[stress (biology)|stress]], [[cognition]], and [[emotion]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nwo.nl/projecten.nsf/pages/1700113787_Eng |title=Stress, cognitie en emotie: onderzoek aan diermodellen voor de pathogenese van stress-gerelateerde ziektes |publisher=Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research |access-date=2012-11-26}}</ref> She obtained her [[Ph.D.]] with the mention [[magna cum laude]] in 1989 from the [[University of Düsseldorf]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.deltaphenomics.com/content/melly-s-oitzl-phd |title=Melly S. Oitzl, Ph.D. |publisher=Delta Phenomics |access-date=2012-11-26}}</ref> Oitzl is a member of the board of the Earth and Life Sciences division of the [[Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://lacdr.nl/news/melly-oitzl-is-new-nwo-alw-board-member |title=Melly Oitzl is new NWO ALW board member |publisher=Leiden/Amsterdam Center for Drug Research |access-date=2012-11-26}}</ref> from which she had received an "Aspasia" grant in 2008.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nwo.nl/projecten.nsf/pages/subsidy_id_eng?opendocument&show=NWOA_4YYAJV&t=Aspasia |title=Aspasia |publisher=Netherlands Organisation for Scientific Research |access-date=2012-11-26}}</ref> She has been a member of the [[executive committee]] and a treasurer of the [[European Brain and Behaviour Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ebbs-science.org/cms/general/committee-members.html |title=Committee members &#124; General |publisher=European Brain and Behaviour Society |access-date=2012-11-26 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120314123152/http://www.ebbs-science.org/cms/general/committee-members.html |archive-date=2012-03-14 }}</ref> According to the [[Web of Science]], Oitzl has published more than 130 articles in [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]]s, which have been cited over 5000 times, with an [[h-index]] of 33.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2012 |chapter=M.S. Oitzl |title=Science Citation Index |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Science Citation Index }}</ref>
